scope: Isolated iPhone native photo selection/save/relaunch/Quick Look/return; Mac Core reader and portable restore. No production changes.

checks: Select synthetic checker through native Photos picker
Open persisted Photo.png in Quick Look: Image canvas is 64 by 64 points; inspected pixels show all four exact checker quadrants
Close preview and return to hittable persisted attachment
Mac-owned Snapshot decoder reads final actual iOS cache
Attachment bytes exactly equal independently owned fixture
Portable cross-account restore retains complete attachment value and identity
Repeated portable restore adds no records

fixture.seed: xcrun simctl addmedia on isolated phone only; newest Photos thumbnail

build: iOS build-for-testing v5 and Mac swift build --build-tests v1 passed; previous app builds reused because production unchanged.
diagnostics: v1 native thumbnail element tap failed with invalid XCTest hit point; observed thumbnail frame centre succeeds. No app defect inferred.
v2 attachment selection/persistence passed; preview capture was taken during transition and is not rendering evidence.
v3 preview pixels pass. Final v5 waits for Image canvas, verifies dimensions and closes preview; v4 build only.
limits: Phone portrait normal/light only; tablet fixture untouched.
No live cloud image handoff, upload, external provider transfer, physical host or Mac native file-dialog acceptance.
No unfiltered audit rerun or VoiceOver/keyboard acceptance.
Mac test requires TASKFOLD_NATIVE_PHOTO_SNAPSHOT; default skip is not acceptance.
Both repositories own their own fixture and tests; no cross-repo build dependency.

cleanup.retained: Final v5 bundle, compact summaries, signing receipt, Mac report and iOS inspected captures.
